# LoomTensionView

A tension with the two threads it joins.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tension` | [`LoomTension`](loom-tension.md) | The tension. |
| `thread1` | [`LoomThread`](loom-thread.md)`\| null` | The first thread. Null if it has since been erased. |
| `thread2` | [`LoomThread`](loom-thread.md)`\| null` | The second thread. Null if it has since been erased. |
